groups.name: raf.async.pools
groups.description: Named async thread pool configurations. Each key is a pool name used with @Async("poolName").

properties.name: raf.async.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable dynamic async thread pools. When enabled, named pools defined under raf.async.pools are registered as Spring task executors.

properties.name: raf.async.pools
properties.description: Named async thread pool configurations. Each key is a pool name used with @Async("poolName").

properties.name: raf.async.pools[*].core-pool-size
properties.description: Core number of threads in this pool.

properties.name: raf.async.pools[*].max-pool-size
properties.description: Maximum number of threads allowed in this pool.

properties.name: raf.async.pools[*].queue-capacity
properties.description: Capacity of the task queue. When the queue is full, new tasks are rejected according to the rejection policy.

properties.name: raf.async.pools[*].keep-alive-seconds
properties.description: Keep-alive time in seconds for idle threads above the core pool size.

properties.name: raf.async.pools[*].thread-name-prefix
properties.description: Prefix for thread names in this pool. Useful for identifying threads in logs and thread dumps.

properties.name: raf.async.pools[*].wait-for-tasks-to-complete-on-shutdown
properties.description: Whether to wait for scheduled tasks to complete on shutdown. Enables graceful shutdown of async tasks.

properties.name: raf.async.pools[*].await-termination-seconds
properties.description: Maximum seconds to wait for remaining tasks to complete on shutdown.

properties.name: raf.cors.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable the global CORS filter.

properties.name: raf.cors.path
properties.description: URL path pattern to which the CORS filter applies.

properties.name: raf.cors.allow-origins
properties.description: Allowed origins. Use '*' to allow all origins (not recommended for production).

properties.name: raf.cors.allow-headers
properties.description: Allowed request headers. Use '*' to allow all headers.

properties.name: raf.cors.allow-methods
properties.description: Allowed HTTP methods, e.g. GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS.

properties.name: raf.cors.allow-expose-headers
properties.description: Response headers that browsers are allowed to access.

properties.name: raf.cors.allow-credentials
properties.description: Whether to allow credentials (cookies, authorization headers). Cannot be used with allow-origins: ['*'].

properties.name: raf.cors.max-age
properties.description: How long in seconds the browser should cache the preflight response.

properties.name: raf.log.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable HTTP request/response audit logging.

properties.name: raf.log.level
properties.description: Audit log verbosity level. Controls how much of the request/response is captured.

properties.name: raf.log.exclude-paths
properties.description: URL path patterns to exclude from audit logging, e.g. /actuator/**, /health.

properties.name: raf.log.max-payload-length
properties.description: Maximum request/response body length in characters to include in the log. Longer payloads are truncated.

values.description: Log HTTP method, URL, status code, and duration only.
Log basic info plus request headers.
Log basic info, request headers, and request body.
Log basic info, request headers, and response headers.
Log full request and response including bodies. Use with caution in production.
